source.title: Claude Fable 5.2 scores 65 on Artificial Analysis, highest so far
source.author: theanonymousone

title.zh: Claude Fable 5.2评测登顶，成本与耗时偏高
title.en: Claude Fable 5.2 Leads Index at a High Cost

excerpt.zh: Claude Fable 5.2在Artificial Analysis智能指数中获得65分，位列页面榜首，但单项任务平均耗时46.4分钟、成本26.54美元，实际应用仍需权衡质量、延迟与预算。
excerpt.en: Claude Fable 5.2 tops the Artificial Analysis index with 65 points, but high task costs and long runtimes complicate its appeal.

disclosure.zh: 本文使用星期天AI中转站大模型，基于 Hacker News 内容自动生成。
disclosure.en: This article was automatically generated by the Weekly Day AI gateway model using content from Hacker News.

text.zh: 据所提供的Artificial Analysis页面，Anthropic的Claude Fable 5.2在智能指数中获得65分，位列页面所列74个模型之首。结果对应“Max, Default Fallback”配置，不能直接推广到其他配置。
text.en: According to the supplied Artificial Analysis page, Anthropic’s Claude Fable 5.2 scores 65 on its Intelligence Index, ranking first among the 74 models listed in the summary. The result applies to the “Max, Default Fallback” configuration and should not automatically be extended to other configurations.

text.zh: 该指数v5.0.1综合九项评测，涉及知识、软件工程、终端操作及专业文档推理等任务。页面将其列为专有推理模型，支持文本和图像输入、文本输出，拥有100万token上下文窗口。综合领先并不意味着它在每项任务中都最强。
text.en: Version 5.0.1 of the index combines nine evaluations covering areas including knowledge, software engineering, terminal use and professional document reasoning. The page describes a proprietary reasoning model with text and image input, text output and a one-million-token context window. Leading the combined index does not establish leadership on every individual task.

text.zh: 领先成绩背后的成本与等待
text.en: The cost and waiting time behind the score

text.zh: 评测中，每项任务平均耗时46.4分钟，可比模型中位数为12.6分钟；每项任务加权平均成本为26.54美元。输入和输出价格分别为每百万token 8美元和40美元。整轮智能指数评测生成2.75亿输出token，也明显高于页面给出的7280万中位数。
text.en: Evaluation tasks averaged 46.4 minutes, compared with a median of 12.6 minutes for comparable models, and the weighted average cost was $26.54 per task. Listed prices are $8 per million input tokens and $40 per million output tokens. Across the Intelligence Index evaluation, the model generated 275 million output tokens, well above the reported median of 72.8 million.

text.zh: 这些结果提示，重视质量且能容忍等待的工作值得进一步测试，但交互应用需要认真衡量延迟与预算。评测均值不是日常请求的成本或耗时预测。页面还标注“无公开可用API”，因此实际接入条件，以及领先成绩能否转化为特定业务收益，仍需确认。
text.en: These results suggest further testing may be worthwhile for work that prioritizes quality and can tolerate waiting, while interactive applications need careful latency and budget checks. Benchmark averages do not predict the cost or duration of ordinary requests. The page also states “No publicly available API,” leaving practical access and the value of the score for specific business tasks unresolved.
